question: Which Indian shuttler defeated World Champion Loh Kean Yew of Singapore in the Men's Singles final at the 2022 India Open?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshya Sen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshya Sen **

 
 
• In the **men's singles final of the India Open 2022, Indian badminton player Lakshya Sen defeated Singaporean World Champion Loh Kean Yew**.
 
• He won his **first Super 500 championship**.
 
• The** 20-year-old Sen defeated Yew** in two games, **24-22 and 21-17**.
 
• The **Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2022**, also known as the **2022 India Open (badminton), took place at the K. D. Jadhav Indoor Hall in New Delhi, India**.
 
• Between J**anuary 11 to January 16, 2022**, the game began.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chirag Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy

 
 
• **Chirag Shetty and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy** defeat** Mohammad Ahsan and Hendra Setiawan of Indonesia** to win the Indian Open for the first time in Men's Double.
 
• In **43 minutes**, Satwik and Chirag defeated the Indonesian pair ranked No. 2 in the world by a **score of 21-16, 26-24**.
 
 
 
• **Srikanth Kidambi**
 
 
• **Indian badminton player Srikanth Kidambi **receives his training at the **Gopichand Badminton Academy in Hyderabad**.
 
• In **April 2018**, according to the **BWF rankings, he held the top spot in the world**.
 
• In** 2018**, Kidambi received the **Padma Shri**, India's fourth-highest civilian honour. as well as the **2015 Arjuna Award**.
